jsonrpc.description: Persistent JSON-RPC entry point. Operation commands are optional fallbacks.

$schema.title: Resource manifest schema URI
$schema.description: The version of the resource manifest schema.

type.description: The namespaced name of the resource.

condition.description: An optional condition for the resource to be active.  If the condition evaluates to false, the resource is skipped.

deprecationMessage.description: An optional message indicating the resource is deprecated.  If provided, the message will be shown when the resource is used.

version.description: The version of the resource using semantic versioning.

get.description: Details how to call the Get method of the resource.

set.description: Details how to call the Set method of the resource.

whatIf.description: Details how to call the `WhatIf` method of the resource.

test.description: Details how to call the Test method of the resource.

delete.description: Details how to call the Delete method of the resource.

export.description: Details how to call the Export method of the resource.

resolve.description: Details how to call the Resolve method of the resource.

validate.description: Details how to call the Validate method of the resource.

adapter.description: Indicates the resource is a adapter of other resources.

exitCodes.description: Mapping of exit codes to descriptions.  Zero is always success and non-zero is always failure.

schema.description: Details how to get the schema of the resource.

executable.description: The command to run to get the state of the resource.

args.description: The arguments to pass to the command to perform a Get.

input.description: How to pass optional input for a Get.

requireSecurityContext.description: The security context required to run the Get method.  Default if not specified is `current`.

adaptedContentArg.description: The argument that accepts the JSON content from the manifest.

arg.description: The argument that accepts the result of the expression.

expression.description: The expression to be evaluated.  `null` result becomes an empty string.

mandatory.description: Indicates if the argument is mandatory.  Default is false.

jsonInputArg.description: The argument that accepts the JSON input object.

mandatory.description: Indicates if argument is mandatory which will pass an empty string if no JSON input is provided.  Default is false.

resourcePathArg.description: The argument that accepts the resource path.

includeQuotes.description: Indicates if the argument should be wrapped in quotes.  Default is false.

resourceTypeArg.description: The argument that accepts the resource type name.

resourceVersionArg.description: The argument that accepts the resource version.

supportsWhatIf.description: Whether JSON-RPC set supports native what-if.

executable.description: The command to run to set the state of the resource.

args.description: The arguments to pass to the command to perform a Set.

input.description: How to pass required input for a Set.

implementsPretest.description: Whether to run the Test method before the Set method.  True means the resource will perform its own test before running the Set method.

handlesExist.description: Indicates that the resource directly handles `_exist` as a property.

return.description: The type of return value expected from the Set method.

requireSecurityContext.description: The security context required to run the Set method.  Default if not specified is `current`.

whatIfReturns.description: The type of return value expected from the Set method when running in what-if mode. When specified, this overrides the `return` property during what-if execution.
